Gives how many saves on other threads (see [AsyncSaving](AsyncSaving)) could not write their file so far, for example because the folder does not exist. Saves that finished are counted as soon as they are asked about, and the number does not go down again. Saves without threads tell about it in the result of the save command instead, and are never counted here.
@returns The number of saves on other threads that failed.

This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no asynchronous saving.
